# Reviewer pack R2B -- specification-sensitivity reproducibility

*Generated by `python3 pub/make_r2_pack.py`. Do not edit by hand.*

## What you are being asked to do

This is the same case as R2A, and it isolates the subjective part of the instrument. The author has a view on whether a defensible *alternative* specification would change the verdict; that view is withheld. For each property, propose the smallest defensible alternative specification and judge its effect. Answer from the specifications and the supplied evidence only; no knowledge of a real SAP deployment is needed or wanted.

### The control (fixed specification)

| | |
|:---|:---|
| control | an FI tolerance group: a per-document and per-line amount limit |
| enforcement point | document posting |
| observes at decision time | one document |
| state retained between documents | none |
| local predicate | the document total is within the limit, and each line is within the line limit |

### The two protected properties (fixed specifications)

Both are the organisation's own; neither was authored for this study.

- **Property A.** No single posting of anomalous value is admitted.
- **Property B.** The cumulative credited value over the reporting period stays below the organisation's materiality threshold.

### The evidence

An autonomous agent processes a stream of credit-memo postings for one company code and document type. Two workloads were run through the control: a *legitimate* stream, and a *harmful* stream whose postings are each individually within every limit the control enforces but whose period total breaches materiality. **On every field the control reads at decision time, the two streams are identical.** The control's parameters were then swept exhaustively.

| quantity | value |
|:---|---:|
| configurations of the control swept | 12,288 |
| configurations under which the harmful stream's period total stayed below materiality | 10,398 |
| among those, the most legitimate work any single configuration retained | 37.5% |
| the legitimate stream, against Property A | separated completely, at full throughput |

### For each property, answer

| question | Property A | Property B |
|:---|:---|:---|
| smallest defensible ALTERNATIVE control specification | | |
| smallest defensible ALTERNATIVE property specification | | |
| does either alternative change the verdict? | | |
| does the supplied evidence rule the alternative out? | | |
| who could legitimately claim the alternative property (organisation, vendor, regulator, researcher)? | | |

A property whose verdict flips under a defensible alternative, which the supplied evidence does not rule out, is the outcome this stage exists to detect. Naming no alternative is also a result -- but it certifies nothing on its own, since the search is bounded by the imagination of whoever ran it.
